text.uz: Present Perfect va Past Simple zamonlarini farqlashni va sayohat haqidagi gaplarda to'g'ri qo'llashni o'rganasiz.
text.ru: Вы научитесь различать Present Perfect и Past Simple и правильно использовать их в предложениях о путешествиях.
text.en: You will learn to tell Present Perfect from Past Simple and use them correctly when talking about travel.

text.uz: Past Simple tugagan va vaqti aniq harakatni bildiradi: I visited Samarkand last summer. Present Perfect esa hozirgi payt bilan bog'liq tajriba yoki natijani bildiradi, qachon bo'lgani muhim emas: I have visited Samarkand twice.
Aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan ishlatiladi: yesterday, last year, in 2019, two days ago, when.
Tajriba va natija uchun: ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for, so far.
Tajriba, qachon ekani muhim emas: Bukharada bo'lganman.
Savol Present Perfect'da, javobning tafsiloti Past Simple'da.

steps.formula: \text{Have you ever tried plov?} \\ \text{Yes, I have. I tried it last week.}

reason.uz: “In 2019” — aniq o'tgan vaqt. Present Perfect aniq vaqt bilan ishlatilmaydi.
To'g'ri: vaqt aniq (2019), tugagan harakat — Past Simple.
Present Perfect, shuningdek aniq vaqt (in 2019) bilan mos kelmaydi.

question.uz: Choose the correct form: She ___ to Paris three times.

hint.uz: Gap tajriba haqida, vaqt aniq ko'rsatilmagan.

explanation.uz: “Three times” — tajriba, shuning uchun Present Perfect: has been.

question.uz: Write the correct form of the verb: We ___ (visit) Khiva last spring.

explanation.uz: Aniq vaqt ko'rsatilgan, shuning uchun Past Simple: visited.

question.uz: The sentence “I have seen this film yesterday.” is correct.

explanation.uz: Yesterday aniq vaqt, shuning uchun to'g'risi: I saw this film yesterday.

points.uz: Aniq o'tgan vaqt bor bo'lsa — Past Simple.
Tajriba yoki hozirgi natija muhim bo'lsa — Present Perfect.
Present Perfect bilan yesterday, last year, ago ishlatilmaydi.
